title: Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Reasoning for Organic Structure Elucidation from Multimodal Spectra
abstract: arXiv:2608.14720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Following the molecular discovery and synthesis revolutions, scalable automated structure elucidation from routine spectroscopic data remains an outstanding challenge. Despite decades of computational efforts, no existing system achieved reliable reasoning over unseen spectra. Here, we propose MACROS, a multi-agent system automating structure elucidation by emulating expert iterative hypothesis-testing. Trained on 100M simulated and 1.6M experimental spectra-molecule pairs, it natively supports arbitrary combinations of routine spectroscopic techniques. It achieves unprecedented zero-shot generalization to diverse real-world samples, correctly identifying synthetic compounds, natural products and metabolites above 500 Da with 1D NMR. translated_title: 多智能体闭环推理用于多模态光谱的有机结构解析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14720v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在分子发现和合成革命之后，从常规光谱数据中进行可扩展的自动化结构解析仍然是一个突出的挑战。尽管经过数十年的计算努力，现有系统仍未能在未见光谱上实现可靠的推理。在此，我们提出了MACROS，一种多智能体系统，通过模拟专家迭代假设检验来自动化结构解析。该系统在1亿个模拟和160万个实验光谱-分子对上训练，原生支持任意常规光谱技术组合。它在多样化的真实世界样本上实现了前所未有的零样本泛化能力，能正确识别合成化合物、天然产物和分子量超过500 Da的代谢物，仅使用1D NMR。值得注意的是，MACROS从无标注数据中自发恢复教科书级的光谱相关性，并展现出涌现的化学直觉，如环优先解析偏好，从而学习基本化学原理。
tldr: 本文提出MACROS，一种多智能体闭环推理系统，通过模拟专家迭代假设检验，在百万级数据训练下实现了对多模态光谱的零样本有机结构解析，并展现出自发学习化学相关性和化学直觉的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MACROS, a multi-agent closed-loop reasoning system that emulates expert iterative hypothesis-testing to achieve unprecedented zero-shot organic structure elucidation from multimodal spectra, demonstrating emergent chemical intuition and spontaneous recovery of spectroscopic correlations.
